'''2001 Chewbacca Con''' was a Star Wars CCG team tournament held at Holiday Inn, Boxborough, Massachusetts on 28 July 2001. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2756">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1d2756/ madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1d2756/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn, Boxborough, Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
